paragraphs.text: The Nova Pentacle , also called the Reflecting Star , was a Dominarian artifact wielded for over a millennium during and after the Ice Age .

The Nova Pentacle was a delicate star about as big as a handspan. The arms of the star were made of wood bound by a silver ring, inside of which was a ring of red gemstone, and at their center, a preserved ant. It was held on a chain of small copper links threaded with linen string. It bound the wearer to the earth, preventing them from planeswalking or being summoned. It also bound them to themself, increasing their power.

The Nova Pentacle was said to be older than any living thing on Dominaria in 4077 AR . Its first known wielder was Samiks of the Marked Ones . After Samiks was poisoned by Lim-Dûl and dying of plague, he gave the artifact to Zaraya , leader of the Knights of Kjeldor , around 2933 AR . Zaraya in turn gave it to Freyalise for Jaeuhl Carthalion to use against Tevesh Szat . He used the pentacle to reflect the Shield of the Ice Prince back at a priest of Yawgmoth .

More than 1100 years later, in 4074 AR , Greensleeves received the Nova Pentacle from the druid Chaney , to help with her magic. Between 4074 and 4077 AR, Towser invisibly stole the Nova Pentacle from Greensleeves and created several copies of it, imbuing them with the original's power. This allowed the spellcasters controlled by the Stone Brain to resist being summoned by Greensleeves's magic.
